$comment: 🔴 NOT A REAL PRODUCT. A fictional full-feature lock that exists ONLY so LockSim can answer Tuya 0x01 with a PID and the bench can exercise PID discovery end to end — ask, parse, match, switch profile, persist, report on info/heartbeat. Before this, none of that had ever run: LockSim did not answer 0x01 and no real Tuya MCU has been on our wire. The PID is deliberately un-Tuya-like so it can never be mistaken for a supplier value. Every DP below was ORIGINALLY selected from the REAL catalogue, so the fiction was in the PRODUCT, not in the DP numbers — a bench pass here says the discovery mechanism works, and says nothing about any shipping lock. 🔴 THAT INVARIANT WAS BROKEN 2026-08-17 by adding fiction DP 1 under `extra` to unblock the bench — see its own $comment there. See ozkey-37.

supplier.module: none — this is LockSim, our own MCU emulator

source.note: Operator: 'for the LOCKSIM we can makeup a PID that has keypad, rfid, doorbell, fingerprint'. Capabilities chosen to make every branch of the app's capability table reachable on the bench.

features.capabilities_note: keypad + RFID + fingerprint + doorbell, i.e. the maximal case. The app's default profile for an UNKNOWN pid is the opposite (RFID + app only), so these two together exercise both ends of its lookup.

extra.name: unlock_channel
extra.$comment: 🔴 BENCH-ONLY FICTION — added 2026-08-17 by operator directive to unblock the bench. NOT a Tuya catalogue DP; it is carried in `extra` precisely because the generator refuses it in `selects` ('selects DP 1, not in catalogue'), and that refusal is correct. WHY IT IS HERE: BANOI and ozlockserv still send DP 1 to unlock. When PID discovery switched LockA off ozkie-legacy-v0 onto this profile, ozDpForwardable(1) started returning false and every app unlock died with '[FWD] REJECTED DP 1'. tuya-ds013-t3 does NOT carry DP 1 either, SO A REAL DS013-T3 WOULD FAIL IDENTICALLY — this entry hides a live cross-team bug on the bench and MUST BE REMOVED once the app/server migrate. DO NOT COPY INTO ANY REAL PRODUCT PROFILE. 🔴 AND THERE IS NO DROP-IN REPLACEMENT: the real remote-unlock command is DP 10 `remote_unlock` (verb lock.unlock) and it is status:reserved — BLOCKED because the supplier never supplied the RAW payload layout (ozkey-27 Q2). DP 72 `unlock_remote` is NOT a substitute: its verb is event.access, i.e. a REPORT that a remote unlock happened with cred_id N, not a command to open. So today there is no usable real remote-unlock DP at all, and that supplier gap — not this line — is the thing that actually needs closing.
